pages.title: A sore throat · 1/3
paragraphs: It is nine o’clock in the morning in Phoenix. Ivo has a sore throat and feels very tired. He walks into a small clinic with a form in his hand. The waiting room is quiet and has soft chairs. A kind doctor stands near the front desk. Her name is Dr. Cruz.
“Good morning. Do you have an appointment?” says Dr. Cruz. “Yes. My name is Ivo Santos.” says Ivo. “Please fill out this form and sit down.” says Dr. Cruz.
